application_instructions_en: Ask the international office of your home university to nominate you, then complete the online form on the Northvale University application page. Decisions are sent by 15 December.
Nomination by your home university is required. Applications are ranked by motivation and prior field experience; places for the field week are limited.
Ask the international office of your home university to nominate you before 31 January 2027. Nominated students receive a link to the registration form.
